en.title: C-V-P (Capitals)
en.decryption: Shishunaga moved the capital to Vaishali, but Kalashoka permanently returned it to Pataliputra.

hi.title: C-V-P (Capitals)
hi.decryption: Shishunaga moved the capital to Vaishali, but Kalashoka permanently returned it to Pataliputra.

fact.en: Confusing Shishunaga's origin: He was an Amamatya (minister) chosen by the people, not a usurper of the Haryanka line by blood.
fact.hi: Confusing Shishunaga's origin: He was an Amamatya (minister) chosen by the people, not a usurper of the Haryanka line by blood.

fact.en: Assuming Vaishali remained the capital throughout the dynasty; it was shifted back to Pataliputra under Kalashoka.
fact.hi: Assuming Vaishali remained the capital throughout the dynasty; it was shifted back to Pataliputra under Kalashoka.
